title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 27: the plastered stones on Mount Ebal, the tribes on two mountains, and the curses.

questions.text: With what were the great stones to be coated?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they were to set up great stones and coat them with plaster.

questions.text: What were the Israelites to write on the stones?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they shall write on them all the words of this law.

answers.text: The names of the twelve tribes
All the words of this law

questions.text: On which mountain were the stones to be set up?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they were to set up these stones on Mount Ebal and coat them with plaster.

questions.text: What tool was not to be used on the stones of the altar?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "You shall not use any iron tool on them." The altar was to be built of uncut stones.

questions.text: Who spoke to all Israel saying, "Be silent and listen, Israel!"?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says Moses and the Levitical priests spoke these words to all Israel.

answers.text: The elders of the tribe of Judah
The judges of all the tribes

questions.text: Which of these tribes stood on Mount Gerizim to bless the people?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 names Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin for Mount Gerizim.

questions.text: Which of these tribes stood on Mount Ebal for the curse?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 names Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali for Mount Ebal.

questions.text: Who were to speak the curses with a loud voice to all the men of Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the Levites shall say them with a loud voice.

questions.text: What were all the people to answer after each curse?
questions.explanation: After each curse, all the people shall answer and say, "Amen."

questions.text: Who is cursed according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: "Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road."

answers.text: He who eats with a foreigner
He who travels on the Sabbath
He who leads the blind astray on the road
